title: FrameScout: Scouting Query-Relevant Frames for Long Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.23975v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Long video understanding requires VideoLLMs to answer queries about videos spanning tens of minutes to hours, but such long videos produce far more visual tokens than current VideoLLMs can process. To address this issue, keyframe selectors are proposed to select the most query-relevant frames by computing the similarity between frame and query embeddings. Existing selectors either encode frames independently without temporal context or process chunks in isolation with ranking objectives that are difficult to optimize. To alleviate those limitations, we propose FrameScout with two core designs: (i) a streaming selector architecture that leverages a sliding-window KV cache and successor aggregation to produce temporally-contextualized frame embeddings; (ii) a frame-query contrastive objective that aligns frame and query embeddings in a shared space, directly training the selector to distinguish relevant frames from irrelevant one

translated_title: FrameScout：为长视频理解搜寻与查询相关的帧
translated_abstract: 长视频理解要求视频大语言模型（VideoLLM）能够回答关于时长跨越数十分钟乃至数小时的视频的查询，但这类长视频产生的视觉令牌数量远超当前VideoLLM所能处理的范围。为解决这一问题，研究者提出了关键帧选择器，通过计算帧嵌入与查询嵌入之间的相似度来选取与查询最相关的帧。然而，现有的选择器要么在编码帧时独立处理、缺乏时间上下文，要么以孤立方式处理视频片段，且所采用的排序目标难以优化。为缓解上述局限，我们提出FrameScout，其包含两项核心设计：(i) 一种流式选择器架构，利用滑动窗口KV缓存和后继聚合机制来生成具有时间上下文的帧嵌入；(ii) 一种帧-查询对比目标，在共享空间中对齐帧嵌入与查询嵌入，直接训练选择器区分相关帧与无关帧。
tldr: 提出FrameScout框架，通过结合滑动窗口KV缓存与后继聚合的流式选择器架构生成时间上下文化的帧嵌入，并利用帧-查询对比学习目标直接训练选择器，从而为长视频理解高效选取与查询最相关的关键帧。
en_tdlr: FrameScout enables efficient long video understanding through a streaming selector architecture with sliding-window KV cache and successor aggregation for temporally-contextualized frame embeddings, combined with a frame-query contrastive objective that directly trains the selector to identify query-relevant frames.
